name: 抱枕松鼠
habitatEn: Evolves from L Ersongshu at Lv.23
evolution: 绿耳松鼠 → 抱枕松鼠 Lv.32 → 蹦床松鼠 Lv.46
evolutionEn: L Ersongshu → Baozhensongshu Lv.32 → Bengchuangsongshu Lv.46
description: 骑着自己的尾巴，已经不需要靠双脚走路。偶尔把头埋进身体，看上去像一颗巨大的果实。
descriptionEn: It rides on its own tail and no longer needs to walk on its two feet. Occasionally it buries its head in its body, looking like a huge fruit.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; counters an attack.

skills.name: 落星
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 拍击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 防反
skills.description: 减伤70%，应对攻击：自己获得物攻和魔攻+70%。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; when countering an attack: the user gains Attack and Magic Attack +70%.

skills.name: 气势一击
skills.description: 造成物伤，若上回合应对成功，本次技能威力+180。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if the counter last turn succeeded, this skill's power +180.

skills.name: 抓挠
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the user restores 1 energy.

skills.name: 蓄能轰击
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每使用1次普通系技能，本技能能耗永久-2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; each time a Normal-type skill is used, this skill's energy cost is permanently -2.

skills.name: 冲撞
skills.description: 造成物伤，回合结束时，本技能能耗永久-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; at the end of the turn, this skill's energy cost is permanently -1.

skills.name: 吓退
skills.description: 减伤60%，应对攻击：敌方脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 60%; when countering an attack: the opponent withdraws.

skills.name: 突袭
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为3倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; when countering: this skill's power becomes 3x.

skills.name: 无畏之心
skills.description: 减伤100%，应对攻击：减免的伤害变为回复自己生命，且本技能能耗永久+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 100%; when countering an attack: the reduced damage becomes healing for the user, and this skill's energy cost is permanently +2.
